what: Fit a censored Gaussian latent block model — censored_lbm
title: Fit a censored Gaussian latent block model — censored_lbm
text: Jointly estimate row memberships, column memberships, class proportions, Gaussian block parameters exact, censored, missing reports. five profiled numerical kernels use compiled Rcpp backend; starts, validity rules, convergence, model control remain R.

title: Fit a censored Gaussian latent block model — censored_lbm
code: censored_lbm(   data,   g,   m,   algorithm = "SS",   S = c("Skl", "Sk", "Sl", "S0"),   P = c("free", "equal"),   n_starts = 20L,   starts = NULL,   seed = 1L,   max_iter = 400L,   tol = 1e-07,   sigma2_min = 1e-08,   effective_weight_min = 1e-08,   monotone_tolerance = 1e-07,   max_start_attempts = NULL,   require_map_nonempty = TRUE,   verbose = FALSE )  # S3 method for class 'cglbm_fit' print(x, ...)  # S3 method for class 'cglbm_fit' summary(object, ...)  # S3 method for class 'cglbm_fit' predict(object, type = c("labels", "memberships", "parameters"), ...)

title: Fit a censored Gaussian latent block model — censored_lbm
text: data new_cglbm_data() object numeric matrix interpreted exact data. g, m Positive numbers row column classes. algorithm Membership configuration: "HH", "HS", "SH", "SS"; first letter refers rows second columns. S Variance structure: block-specific ("Skl"), shared row class ("Sk"), shared column class ("Sl"), globally shared ("S0"). P Class-proportion structure: estimated freely ("free") fixed equally ("equal"). n_starts Number valid starts requested. starts Optional ordered list starts, containing integer vectors z w. seed Integer random seed. max_iter Maximum GEM iterations per start. tol Relative objective convergence tolerance. sigma2_min Positive variance floor. effective_weight_min Minimum admissible row, column, observed block mass. monotone_tolerance Allowed numerical decrease retained GEM substep. max_start_attempts Maximum attempted starts. require_map_nonempty Require every declared class final MAP partitions. verbose Emit per-attempt progress messages. x cglbm_fit object. ... Additional arguments, currently unused. object cglbm_fit object. type One "labels", "memberships", "parameters".

title: Fit a censored Gaussian latent block model — censored_lbm
text: cglbm_fit object containing memberships, MAP labels, fitted parameters, objective diagnostics, Fisher-information summaries. summary.cglbm_fit() returns data frame one row per block; predict.cglbm_fit() returns labels, memberships, parameters.

title: Fit a censored Gaussian latent block model — censored_lbm
code: y <- matrix(c(-2.1, -1.9, 1.9, 2.1,               -2.0, -1.8, 1.8, 2.0), nrow = 4) dat <- exact_cglbm_data(y) fit <- censored_lbm(   dat, g = 2, m = 1, algorithm = "HH",   n_starts = 1,   starts = list(list(z = c(1L, 1L, 2L, 2L), w = rep(1L, 2))),   max_iter = 30, max_start_attempts = 1, seed = 1 ) predict(fit, type = "labels") #> $z #> [1] 1 1 2 2 #>  #> $w #> [1] 1 1 #>  summary(fit) #>   K L fitted_mean standard_error fitted_variance effective_block_weight #> 1 1 1       -1.95      0.0559017          0.0125                      4 #> 2 2 1        1.95      0.0559017          0.0125                      4 #>   exact_count left_censored_count right_censored_count nominal_cell_count #> 1           4                   0                    0                  4 #> 2           4                   0                    0                  4 #>   effective_sample_size #> 1                     4 #> 2                     4

title: Complete censored reports before co-clustering — complete_boundary
text: Completion comparators used accompanying manuscript. Boundary half/double substitution deterministic. Truncated-normal multiple imputation require explicit seeds. Completed matrices returned exact cglbm_data objects.

code: complete_boundary(data)  complete_halfdouble(data, analysis_scale = c("log", "log2"))  complete_truncnorm(data, seed)  complete_mi(data, seed, m = 10L, burnin = 50L, thin = 20L)  pool_mi_fits(fits)

text: data cglbm_data object. analysis_scale Scale used half/double substitution. seed Integer random seed. m Number multiple-imputation matrices. burnin Number initial sampler iterations discarded. thin Iterations retained imputations. fits List fitted CGLBM objects multiple imputations.

title: Complete censored reports before co-clustering — complete_boundary
text: complete_boundary(), complete_halfdouble(), complete_truncnorm() return exact cglbm_data object. complete_mi() returns list completed numeric matrices, parameter draws, sampler diagnostics. pool_mi_fits() returns pooled cglbm_fit fitting completed matrices separately.

title: CGLBM 0.1.0
text: Initial package release. Fits censored Gaussian latent block models HH, HS, SH, SS membership configurations. Supports exact, left-censored, right-censored, finite-interval, missing reports. Supports Skl, Sk, Sl, S0 variance structures free equal class proportions. Provides ICL-based class-number selection, block-mean Fisher-information summaries, completion comparators, censoring-aware column centering. Uses package-native Rcpp backend five profiled numerical kernels.
